<!-- Build-time CMS content includes both languages; CSS shows the active one. -->

::: {.docs-glossary data-src="data/docs/glossary.json"}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
const searchBox = document.getElementById("searchBox");

window.addEventListener("atlas:lang", (e) => {
  searchBox.placeholder =
    e.detail === "fr" ? "Rechercher dans le glossaire..." : "Search glossary...";
});

searchBox.addEventListener("input", () => {
  const q = searchBox.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll(".docs-glossary .glossary-entry").forEach((el) => {
    el.hidden = Boolean(q) && !el.dataset.search.includes(q);
  });
  // hide section headings whose entries are all filtered out
  document.querySelectorAll(".docs-glossary h2").forEach((h2) => {
    let el = h2.nextElementSibling;
    let any = false;
    while (el && el.tagName !== "H2") {
      if (el.classList.contains("glossary-entry") && !el.hidden) any = true;
      el = el.nextElementSibling;
    }
    h2.hidden = !any;
  });
});
</script>
```
